test_NamedDiscrete_empty_space: test that NamedDiscrete raises ValueError when initialized with an empty list of values
test_NamedDiscrete_name_lookup: test that NamedDiscrete raises ValueError when looking up a name that does not exist in the space
test_NamedDiscrete_space_size: test that NamedDiscrete returns the correct number of values via the n property
test_NamedDiscrete_to_string: test that NamedDiscrete to_string converts integer indices back to their corresponding named string values
test_NamedDiscrete_equality: test that NamedDiscrete equality comparison works correctly for matching and non-matching spaces
